description: This file defines a class `HolidayMenuConfigurator` implementing a menu configuration interface for the OrangeHRM leave module. It sets up the configuration for the holiday viewing screen within the leave plugin.

classes.name: HolidayMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Defines menu configuration logic for holiday-related screens in the leave module of OrangeHRM. Implements the MenuConfigurator interface and uses a trait for module screen helpers.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the screen by overriding it with 'viewHolidayList'.
